_note: TileVGA card — rene6502/6502-vga-prop (public domain). Parallax P8X32A Propeller driving 320x240 VGA, 40x30 tiles of 8x8 pixels, 16-of-64 colors via R-2R DAC. 16K dual-port VRAM window (reads AND writes). VRAM map: ctrl_cmd $0200 (vblank copy bits), tilemap $0210-$0B6F (40x30x2), palettes $0B70-$0C6F (16x16 color bytes %RRGGBB00), frame counter $0C70 (16-bit LE, card-written every vblank), user charset $0C80-$2C7F (256 chars, 4bpp). System font: funscii (public domain, by Wuerfel21). Machine-level chip; bus terminal is a placeholder for machine-level wiring. Provenance: rene6502 6502-vga-prop (public domain), funscii font (public domain, Wuerfel21).
